messages.content: long distance relationship e trust build kora ta ki kore start korte hoy

Prothome shurute e expectation gulo clear kore neya lage - koto baar kotha hobe, ki update share korte hobe, eishob niye assumption na rekhe direct kotha bola. Tarpor consistency important, chhoto chhoto promise rakha - jemon bole rakha time e call kora - eta boro trust build kore shomoy niye. Third, jealousy ba insecurity ashle sheta hide na kore openly discuss kora, accusation na kore. Ar sabsheshe, occasional visit ba plan thaka lage jate relationship ta shudhu phone screen e limited na theke real feel hoy.
